question: Should OpenClaw accept a shared-state schema v6 migration for durable local marketplace watches and their bounded update history?
rationale: The repository policy reserves SQLite schema-version advances for explicit user discussion and acceptance; this is a persistent product contract and cannot be resolved by a mechanical patch change alone.

options.title: Approve the v6 state contract
options.body: Accept the two new durable tables and upgrade behavior, then require refreshed current-head runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep watches out of shared state
options.body: Request a redesign that avoids advancing the shared SQLite schema until the storage contract is separately accepted.

recommendation.title: Approve the v6 state contract
recommendation.body: Accept the two new durable tables and upgrade behavior, then require refreshed current-head runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: A shared-state schema owner must make the storage-contract decision, but the available review context does not identify that person.
